description: Return Saturn's Sade Sati and related transit windows for the chart, with dates. 'sadeSati' holds the ~7.5-year Sade Sati periods two ways: 'degreeBased' (Saturn within ±45° of the natal Moon) and 'signBased' (Saturn in the 12th/1st/2nd signs from the Moon, each split into phase1/phase2/phase3 with sign, house and start/end dates); it also reports 'moonDegree' and 'moonSign'. 'moonTransits' and 'ascendantTransits' give Saturn's transit periods over the Moon and Ascendant, and 'ascendantDegree'/'ascendantSign' give the reference Ascendant. Each period has startDate, endDate and a description. Data only — no interpretation is added.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST

name: get_saturn_transit
title: Saturn Transit (Sade Sati)
